department: Faculty of Science — Division of Materials Science and Engineering (Department of Physics)

deadline.value: Main Round and HKPFS application deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (Clearing Round: March 31, 2027).
deadline.quote: CUHK Application Deadline: 1 December 2026 (Main round) and 31 March 2027 (Clearing round)

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test score (in Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics) is listed as optional on the Division admissions page (note ETS discontinued the Chemistry Subject Test in May 2023).
gre_subject.quote: [Optional] Provide Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Subject Test Score

supervisor.value: Potential applicants are encouraged to contact individual professors before making selections to discuss research fit and openings.
supervisor.quote: Before making selections, potential applicants are encouraged to contact the individual professors to find out more about their research, their group and what kind of students they are looking for.

funding.value: Regular students receive HK$19,100 - HK$19,660 per month with no separate application required (HKPFS awardees receive HK$28,700/month).
funding.quote: Fee and Financial Support | Regular students: HKD19,100-19,660 per month (separate application is not required)

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits both bachelor's holders (direct to pre-candidacy PhD or MPhil stream) and master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Articulated MPhil-PhD programmes provide a pathway for students with a Bachelor's degree to pursue a PhD. Initially, students are admitted as either MPhil students or pre-candidacy PhD students.

notes: Administered by the Graduate Division of Materials Science and Engineering hosted in the Department of Physics; shortlisted PhD applicants are invited to an entrance exam/interview in December or February.
